# SBFB workflow agents — agent index

> Deterministic multi-agent workflows executed by a host-side Rust runtime:
> signed portable packs (`SBFBPromptAgentPack.v1`), an authoritative compiler
> (`CompiledPlan.v1`), and a durable SQLite run store. This index points an
> agent at the rank-1 sources for the parts DELIVERED so far — it is seeded at
> **S83 Phase I1** with the run store loopback read family and grows with each
> phase; the chantier-wide closure (full GUIDE + every contract) is the S83
> wrap-up (Phase AJ1).
>
> **Status: UNDER CONSTRUCTION (S83).** Delivered at this seed: pack format
> (F), language + agent definitions (G), compiler (H), durable run store (I),
> run store loopback READ surface (I1), deterministic orchestrator (J),
> effect layer — activities, retries, idempotence, outcome_unknown (K).
> Permissions (L), adapters (N/O) and the Workflow Hub app are later phases —
> a fact about them absent from a rank-1 repo file is **`Not evidenced`**.
>
> **Truth Stack** (trust the higher rank on conflict):
> `repo files > .planning/active/ > commits > prompts > chat`.

## Start here

- [WORKFLOW_AGENTS_OVERVIEW.md](../factory/WORKFLOW_AGENTS_OVERVIEW.md): the
  chantier GUIDE (4 authority layers, invariants, phase map). Grows each
  phase; finalized at AJ1.
- [REFERENCE.md](./REFERENCE.md): human twin of this index — the run store
  loopback API family (envelopes, tiers, invariants).

## Run store loopback surface (rank-1 source, S83 Phase I1)

- [workflow_api.rs](../../crates/nexus-shell-daemon/src/workflow_api.rs): the 2
  `/api/daemon/workflow/*` route handlers (READ-ONLY family; routes stay
  registered in `http.rs` `build_router`/`authed_routes` — loopback bearer +
  Host + Origin, peer creds at the listener). Aggregate per-run projection
  `crates/nexus-shell-daemon/src/workflow_api.rs:workflow_run_response`
  (scalar allowlist — never a raw `RunEvent`, snapshot or effect receipt) +
  raw lease row `crates/nexus-shell-daemon/src/workflow_api.rs:workflow_lease_response`.
  `run_id` is server-validated at the route
  (`crates/nexus-shell-daemon/src/workflow_api.rs:valid_run_id`, bounded
  charset, 400 on violation; a run_id never forms a filesystem path).
- [store.rs](../../crates/sbfb-workflow-engine/src/store.rs): the durable run
  store the routes read (journal + outbox + inbox + snapshots + lease;
  single-writer epoch-CAS fencing; forward-only migrations, downgrade guard
  at open). The daemon holds ONE boot-opened handle and acquires NO lease at
  I1 — reads are unfenced-safe under WAL; the write path is the Phase J
  runtime.
- [run_event.rs](../../crates/sbfb-workflow-core/src/run_event.rs): the
  `RunEvent.v1` envelope (LOCAL store format, `RUN_EVENT_FORMAT_VERSION`
  never a wire version; `DOMAIN_RUN_EVENT_V1` stays RESERVED 0-producer).
- [LOOPBACK_ENDPOINTS_TRUST_TIERS.md](../security/LOOPBACK_ENDPOINTS_TRUST_TIERS.md):
  D7 inventory §3 — the T0 representative row for this family, plus the 3
  MUTATING endpoints (restore / gc / lease-force) tier-classified **T1,
  re-routed to Phase V** (the "Centre des Runs" operator surface) by Phase K
  (they do NOT exist in the router today; K is engine-only).
- [THREAT_MODEL.md](../security/THREAT_MODEL.md): §19 asset A11 + the
  T-RUN-* rows, plus §19.2 (asset A12) — the effect layer's own threats
  (v26 = the Phase K effect surface).

## Contract tests (drift gates)

- `golden_http_workflow_domain` + `golden_families_stable` probes in
  [test_support.rs](../../crates/nexus-shell-daemon/src/test_support.rs):
  the EMPTY-NODE contract of both routes, replayed against two fresh nodes.
- In-module tests in `workflow_api.rs`: projection allowlist key-set pin,
  duress-identical behaviour, bounded `run_id` guard.
